{{Quote|Attention unidentified vessel, this is the Republic cruiser Aurora. You are in a restricted zone. Prepare to be brought aboard for a full inspection. If you offer any resistance, we will open fire.|Captain Ofaree, to the [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|Hunter's ''D5-Mantis'' Patrol Craft]]|<ref name="TOR:TMK" />}}
'''Ofaree''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who was in command onboard the [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You think you'd fare any better against a Jedi Master? Time to join your friend in the brig. You can plea your case when we ship you to Coruscant to stand trial.|Captain Ofaree, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:TMK" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Captain Ofaree worked alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]] while serving as a deep space commando training center where Elite Special forces units practice boarding action scenarios. He was later killed by the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] who was here to kill the Jedi and [[Tarro Blood]].<ref name="TOR:TMK" />
